name: wp-mc-eid-mailchimp
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] mc_cid / mc_eid are captured click IDs and yield channel 'Mailchimp' (email-platform signals, clicutcl-attribution.js:332). Engine has neither key nor email-channel concept.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT (standing, ruled #1): mc_cid/mc_eid are NOT captured click IDs in the engine (plugin extras dropped as storage-only legacy; documented portable contract lists exactly the engine's 10 keys). Engine keeps the UTM touch only; 'Mailchimp' label reserved but its mc_* trigger is gone.
